final_answer.key_evidence_summary: All ts-* workloads (secrets e.g. ts-order-other-mysql: ORDER_OTHER_MYSQL_HOST=tsdb-mysql-leader, port 3306) share the single MySQL instance tsdb-mysql. tsdb-mysql's own container logs continuously emit '[Warning] Too many connections' (GetErrorLogs: 325 errors, single pattern, ratio 0.2228), i.e. the server refuses new connections while the port itself is reachable (CheckServiceConnectivity tsdb-mysql-leader:3306 open on all 3 nodes). Consequently ~16 client pods across worker-01/02/03 fail JPA/Hikari startup with 'java.sql.SQLNonTransientConnectionException: Too many connections', 'SQL Error: 1040, SQLState: 08004', 'Unable to build Hibernate SessionFactory' and exit with code 1 -> CrashLoopBackOff (ts-order-other-service pod: Reason Error, Exit Code 1, Restart Count 3, BackOff event). The affected Service has no endpoints (Endpoints empty) and TCP connect to ts-order-other-service:12032 fails from all three nodes, while services that won a connection slot (ts-assurance-service:18888) remain reachable - a database connection exhaustion on the tsdb-mysql data-service instance, not a network/port/addressing or node fault (outages span all three worker nodes).
